lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gills. The spots exhibit a semi-regular spacing, forming a staggered grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of white blobs to create a coordinate-like grid system where the blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light-reflective superior edge to a shadowed inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated horizontal mark is present on the posterior-lateral flank, situated between the mid-line and the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-frequency distribution of small high-luminance blobs is concentrated on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
